questions.stem: 相較於一般藥物，罕病藥物貴得多，因此那些終身需要用藥的人往往負擔不起。
questions.answer: Compared with conventional drugs, medications for rare diseases are far more costly, so those who need them for life often cannot afford them.
accepted_answers: Compared to common medicines, drugs for rare diseases are far more expensive, so those who need them for the rest of their lives often can't afford them.
Compared with regular medicines, rare disease drugs are much more costly, so those who must take them for life are often unable to afford them.

questions.stem: 然而，無論價格訂得多高，專為少數病人開發的新藥往往都無法回收研發成本。
questions.answer: However, no matter how high their prices are, new drugs developed specifically for a few patients often fail to recover their development costs.
accepted_answers: However, no matter how high the prices are, new medicines developed for a small number of patients often fail to cover the cost of research and development.
However, no matter how high the prices may be, new drugs developed specifically for a few patients often cannot make back their development costs.

patterns: 讓步：無論…（no matter how high …）
分詞片語後位修飾名詞（developed for …）

1.explanation_zh: 「相較於一般藥物」用過去分詞片語 Compared with ordinary drugs，主要子句「罕病藥物貴得多」用比較級 medicines for rare diseases are much more expensive（加強用 much／far，不用 very）。「那些終身需要用藥的人」是 those who need them for life（those who + 複數動詞）。「負擔不起」是 cannot afford，不是 burden。
evidence: 那些終身需要用藥的人
1.strategy_zh: 「相較於 A，B 更…」用 Compared with A, B is more …；「那些…的人」用 those who + V。
hints: 切成四段：相較於一般藥物／罕病藥物貴得多／因此那些終身需要用藥的人／往往負擔不起
標的詞彙：compare（相較）、ordinary（一般的）、drug（藥物）、rare（罕見的）、disease（疾病）、expensive（昂貴的）、need（需要）、life（一生）、afford（負擔得起）
句型框架：Compared with + N, S + are much more + adj., so those who + V … often cannot afford them.

2.explanation_zh: 「無論價格訂得多高」是讓步子句 no matter how high their prices are set，how high 要連在一起，後面用直述句語序。「專為少數病人開發的新藥」修飾語在前，英文用過去分詞片語後位修飾 new drugs developed for only a few patients（新藥是被開發的）。「無法回收研發成本」寫 cannot recover their development costs，「研發成本」用名詞 development，不用動詞 develop。
evidence: 專為少數病人開發的新藥
2.strategy_zh: 「無論多＋形容詞」用 no matter how + adj. + S + V；「為…開發的＋名詞」用「名詞 + developed for …」。
hints: 切成四段：然而，無論價格訂得多高／專為少數病人開發的新藥／往往都無法回收／研發成本
標的詞彙：high（高的）、price（價格）、develop（開發）、patient（病人）、new（新的）、recover（回收）、development（研發）、cost（成本）
句型框架：However, no matter how high + S + are set, N + p.p. + for … + often cannot recover + N.

bonus.text: Far pricier than ordinary drugs, medicines for rare diseases often lie beyond the reach of those who need them for life.
bonus.explanation_zh: 句首形容詞片語 Far pricier than …（比…貴得多）補充說明主詞，beyond the reach of …（…負擔不起、拿不到）是進階搭配；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「相較於一般藥物」用 Compared with ordinary drugs，主要子句再用比較級 much more expensive；「那些終身需要用藥的人」改成 those who need them for life，關係子句放在 those 後面。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：「相較於一般藥物」Compared with／to (In comparison with) ordinary／common／regular／other drugs (medicines)；把比較對象改放句中寫成 … much more expensive than ordinary drugs、或寫 Unlike ordinary drugs 也可以（比較由 much more expensive 表達，仍算達成本句 COMP 標的）；「罕病藥物」medicines／drugs／medications for rare diseases、rare disease drugs；「貴得多」are much／far／a lot more expensive (costly)、cost much more；「因此」so／as a result／therefore（只用 and 連接沒有譯出因果，這一部分扣分）；「那些終身需要用藥的人」those who need them for life (for the rest of their lives)、those who must／have to take them for life、those who need lifelong medication；「往往負擔不起」often cannot (can't) afford them、are often unable to afford them。另外也給分：藥物寫不可數的單數 medicine (medication) for rare diseases is much more expensive、afford it；people／patients who …；orphan drugs；are many times more expensive。

bonus.text: However high their prices are set, new drugs developed for only a handful of patients seldom earn back what it cost to develop them.
bonus.explanation_zh: However high = No matter how high；a handful of（少數幾個）、earn back what it cost to develop them（賺回開發所花的錢）是進階寫法。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「無論價格訂得多高」用 no matter how high their prices are set（how high 放在一起）；「專為少數病人開發的新藥」改成分詞片語後位修飾 new drugs developed for only a few patients；「研發成本」是名詞片語 development costs。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：「然而」However；「無論價格訂得多高」no matter how high（however high）their／the prices are (set)、the price is (set)、they are priced；regardless of how high … 也算達成本句 ADVCL 標的；「專為少數病人開發的新藥」new drugs (medicines) developed (specially／specifically) for only a few／a small number of／very few patients，寫成 new drugs that are developed for … 也算達成本句 PART 標的；「往往都無法回收」often cannot／fail to + recover／cover／earn back／make back，are often unable to recover；「研發成本」(their／the) development costs、the cost(s) of (research and) development、the cost of developing them。另外也給分：no matter how expensive they are、regardless of how high the price is；new drugs designed／made for a small group of patients；recoup、can rarely (hardly) recover；R&D costs、research costs。

1.translation: Compared with ordinary medicines, drugs for rare diseases are much more expensive, so those who need to take them for life often cannot afford them.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於」用 Compared with；「貴得多」用 much more expensive；「那些終身需要用藥的人」用 those who need to take them for life；「負擔不起」用 cannot afford。

2.translation: However, no matter how high their prices are set, new drugs developed specifically for a small number of patients often cannot recover their research and development costs.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論價格訂得多高」用 no matter how high their prices are set；「專為少數病人開發的新藥」用過去分詞 developed specifically for 後位修飾；「回收研發成本」用 recover research and development costs。

1.translation: Compared with ordinary drugs, rare-disease drugs are much more expensive, so those who need medication for life often cannot afford them.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於一般藥物」用 Compared with ordinary drugs；「貴得多」用 much more expensive；「因此」以 so 連接兩個子句；「那些終身需要用藥的人」用 those who need medication for life；「負擔不起」用 cannot afford them。

2.translation: However, no matter how high the price is set, new drugs developed for a small number of patients often cannot make back their research and development costs.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論價格訂得多高」用 no matter how high the price is set（被動語態）；「專為少數病人開發的新藥」用過去分詞片語 developed for a small number of patients 修飾 new drugs；「無法回收研發成本」用 cannot make back their research and development costs（也可用 recover）。
